title: Tools
subtitle: Browser-only developer utilities and recon tools I build and use.

items.name: Tools Hub
items.description: All browser-only developer utilities in one place.

items.name: JSON
items.description: Format, validate, and minify JSON.

items.name: JWT
items.description: Decode and verify JSON Web Tokens.

items.name: Base64
items.description: Encode and decode Base64 text.

items.name: UUID
items.description: Generate v4 and v7 UUIDs in bulk.

items.name: Cron
items.description: Explain and preview cron schedules.

items.name: Timestamp
items.description: Convert Unix time across zones, IST first.

items.name: Hash & HMAC
items.description: Compute hashes and HMAC signatures.

items.name: URL
items.description: Encode/decode URLs and parse query strings.

items.name: Diff
items.description: Compare two blocks of text line by line.

items.name: Regex
items.description: Test and debug regular expressions.

items.name: QR Code
items.description: Generate QR codes from text or URLs.

items.name: Convert
items.description: Convert between JSON, YAML, and CSV.

items.name: JWT Sign
items.description: Sign a JWT with HS, RS, PS, ES, or EdDSA in the browser.

items.name: chmod Calculator
items.description: Convert Unix permissions between octal and rwx.

items.name: Color Converter
items.description: Convert colors between hex, rgb, and hsl with contrast checks.

items.name: User-Agent Parser
items.description: Parse browser, engine, OS, and device from a user-agent string.

items.name: X.509 Certificate
items.description: Parse PEM or DER certificates, SANs, and fingerprints.

items.name: SSH Key
items.description: Inspect a public SSH key's type, size, and fingerprints.

items.name: Markdown
items.description: Preview Markdown with safe rendering.

items.name: Password Generator
items.description: Generate passwords and passphrases with entropy estimates.

items.name: CIDR / Subnet
items.description: Calculate IPv4 and IPv6 ranges, masks, and subnet splits.

items.name: GST Calculator
items.description: Split CGST/SGST/IGST and read amounts in lakh/crore.

items.name: DNS Lookup
items.description: Resolve A, AAAA, MX, TXT, and NS records.

items.name: Reverse DNS
items.description: Find PTR records for an IP address.

items.name: HTTP Headers
items.description: Inspect response headers and security flags.

items.name: Subdomains
items.description: Discover subdomains from certificate transparency logs.

items.name: TLS Certificate
items.description: Inspect the certificate chain and expiry.

items.name: Redirects
items.description: Trace a URL's full redirect chain.

items.name: Email Security
items.description: Check SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and MTA-STS.

items.name: RDAP
items.description: Look up registration data for domains, IPs, and ASNs.

items.name: DNSSEC
items.description: Verify the DNSSEC chain of trust from the root.

items.name: MTA-STS
items.description: Check MTA-STS and TLS-RPT policy in depth.

items.name: DANE
items.description: Validate SMTP TLSA records with DNSSEC.

items.name: security.txt
items.description: Check a site's security.txt against RFC 9116.

items.name: robots.txt
items.description: Fetch and parse robots.txt groups, rules, and sitemaps.

items.name: CAA Policy
items.description: Inspect CAA records and cross-check allowed issuers.

items.name: HSTS Preload
items.description: Check HSTS preload eligibility.

items.name: RPKI
items.description: Validate route origins against RPKI data.

items.name: llms.txt
items.description: Check a site's llms.txt and optional llms-full.txt without crawling linked pages.

items.name: BIMI
items.description: Check a BIMI record, logo, and VMC/evidence.

items.name: App links
items.description: Inspect Digital Asset Links and Apple App Site Association documents.

items.name: Pastebin
items.description: Share text with expiry and burn-after-read.

items.name: Request Bin
items.description: Capture and inspect incoming webhooks.
